subject: Vendor onboarding: payment-term structure for Aurora Systems
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: payment-term structure for Aurora Systems

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for completing the onboarding form last week. We just kicked off internal procurement and finance review for Aurora Systems. A couple of quick items we need to lock down before I can push the PO through:

- Preferred payment term: Redwood's standard is Net 30. Finance can consider Net 45 for strategic partners, but Net 60 is unusual and will need executive approval.
- Early-pay options: Finance sometimes supports a pay-early discount program (we run via Tipalti/PrimeRevenue) for vendors who want faster payments.
- Bank details + W-9: we still need your W-9 and banking info to complete vendor activation.

Can you confirm Aurora's preferred payment term and whether you'd accept a Net 45 standard with an early-pay discount option (we typically offer a 0.5–1% fee for 10–20 day pay windows)? If Net 60 is a hard requirement, flag that and I will escalate procurement + finance.

Attached: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist).

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aurora-systems.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP Ops <ap@aurora-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment-term structure for Aurora Systems

Hi David —

Appreciate the note. Short answers up front: Aurora's standard is Net 60 due to our internal cashflow cadence across multinational contracts. We're happy to participate in an early-pay program — we typically offer a 1% discount for payments within 15 days.

I've attached our W-9 and the completed vendor form you requested. We can also supply bank details after we confirm the next steps on your PO and any DocuSign routing.

Attachments:
- aurora_w9.pdf (pdf)
- aurora_vendor_form.docx (docx)

If Net 45 is a path forward, we'd be open to that as long as the early-pay option is made available (1% for P-15). If Net 30 is required without early-pay, we'll need to route to our CFO for approval, which will add time.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Finance Operations
Aurora Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment-term structure for Aurora Systems

David / Kim —

Reviewing Aurora's note & attachments. Quick thoughts from procurement:

- Risk profile: Aurora is a mid-market infra provider with a clean references list; procurement is comfortable with Net 45 for initial engagements.
- Commercial trade-off: If we move to Net 45 + early-pay option (1% for 15 days), our effective cost is lower than a straight Net 30 at list price in many cases.
- Internal ops: If Finance can approve an early-pay pipeline for them (we run a pilot with a few vendors each quarter), we can avoid escalations and keep onboarding on the normal path.

Proposed next step: finance to propose a concrete early-pay offer (discount %, payment window) and we issue the PO with standard Net 45 language and an addendum describing the early-pay program. I've attached the PO template I usually use.

Attachment: redwood_po_template.pdf

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aurora-systems.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment-term structure for Aurora Systems

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the attachments and context. Finance has reviewed and is prepared to run a short onboarding pilot for Aurora with the following terms:

- Standard payment term: Net 45 (issue PO on Net 45)
- Early-pay option: 0.5% discount if invoices are submitted and paid within 20 calendar days (via our early-pay vendor program)
- Cap the early-pay volume for the first 90 days to $150k to limit exposure while we collect performance metrics

If that aligns with Aurora's expectations, please:
1) Confirm acceptance of Net 45 + 0.5% @ 20 days (or counter with the 1% @ 15 days proposal),
2) Provide bank details for ACH (we prefer vendor-initiated enrollment), and
3) Sign the PO / payment addendum — we'll send a DocuSign link once you confirm.
